body: Lazy-loaded heavy deps in mdx-viewer and their first-render triggers: mermaid -> Mermaid component (```mermaid fence); db-schema-toolkit -> SchemaBlock (```sql/prisma/dbml); markmap-lib/markmap-view -> MindMap (```mindmap fence); shiki core+grammars -> CodeBlock. All gated behind code-fence interception in MDXViewer's custom 'code' component (~lines 276-372) which routes special langs away from Shiki to interactive renderers.
